You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From 4396a73115fc8739083536162e2228c0c0c3ed1a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Amir Goldstein <amir73il@gmail.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2021 14:56:34 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] fsnotify: fix sb_connectors leak

Fix a leak in s_fsnotify_connectors counter in case of a race between
concurrent add of new fsnotify mark to an object.

The task that lost the race fails to drop the counter before freeing
the unused connector.

Following umount() hangs in fsnotify_sb_delete()/wait_var_event(),
because s_fsnotify_connectors never drops to zero.

Fixes: ec44610fe2b8 ("fsnotify: count all objects with attached connectors")
Reported-by: Murphy Zhou <jencce.kernel@gmail.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/linux-fsdevel/20210907063338.ycaw6wvhzrfsfdlp@xzhoux.usersys.redhat.com/
Signed-off-by: Amir Goldstein <amir73il@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Linus Torvalds <torvalds@linux-foundation.org>

diff --git a/fs/notify/mark.c b/fs/notify/mark.c
index 95006d1d29ab..fa1d99101f89 100644
--- a/fs/notify/mark.c
+++ b/fs/notify/mark.c
@@ -531,6 +531,7 @@ static int fsnotify_attach_connector_to_object(fsnotify_connp_t *connp,
 		/* Someone else created list structure for us */
 		if (inode)
 			fsnotify_put_inode_ref(inode);
+		fsnotify_put_sb_connectors(conn);
 		kmem_cache_free(fsnotify_mark_connector_cachep, conn);
 	}
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `fs/notify/mark.c`**
   - A new line was added to the function `fsnotify_attach_connector_to_object`. Specifically, the line `fsnotify_put_sb_connectors(conn);` was introduced before the call to `kmem_cache_free`. This line is responsible for decrementing the `s_fsnotify_connectors` counter when a connector is no longer needed.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification addresses a race condition that occurs when multiple tasks attempt to add new fsnotify marks to an object concurrently. If one task loses the race, it fails to decrement the `s_fsnotify_connectors` counter before freeing the connector, leading to a memory leak. By adding the line to decrement the counter, the patch ensures that the counter is properly managed, preventing it from hanging during the `umount()` process in `fsnotify_sb_delete()` and ensuring that resources are correctly released. This fix is crucial for maintaining the integrity of the filesystem notification system and preventing potential deadlocks.

2. output the file name that is most likely to cause the bug.
